newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Quantum, Astro in China venture.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Quantum, Astro in China venture.

text.p: Quantum Resources Ltd and Astro Mining NL said on Friday they had entered into an exclusive seven-year diamond prospecting agreement with the autonomous northwest Chinese region of Xinjiang.
The Xinjiang Bureau Of Geology and Mineral Resources would hold 30 percent of a joint venture, Quantum 51 percent and Astro 19 percent, they said in a joint statement.

They said Chinese geologists had identified micro diamonds from a small sample of 10 tonnes washed from a kimberlite pipe in one location, while elsewhere local farmers had recovered several gem quality diamonds of up to 1.5 carats.
The primary source of the diamonds had not been located, and the joint venture would conduct bulk testing and low level aeromagnetic surveys.
Quantum and Astro said they had the right to select any areas within Xinjiang province for exploration, and would fund all exploration and feasibility studies.
Quantum and Astro are part of mining entrepreneur Joseph Gutnick's stable of companies, led by Great Central Mines NL.
Xinjiang covers about 1.6 million sq km, or a sixth of China's land mass, and was partly bordered by Mongolia and Kazakhstan, the two companies said.
